login.title: Log in to your account
login.sub: Track spending faster — just snap the receipt.
login.error: Incorrect email or password. Check again, or use Forgot password.
login.unverified: Your email isn't verified yet. Open the link in the email from Kasku, or resend the verification email.
login.verifyFailed: The verification link is invalid or already used. Try logging in, or request a new verification email.
login.passwordChanged: Your password was changed. Log in with your new password.

register.title: Create account
register.sub: Free. All your records stay safe and synced across devices.
register.name: Full name
register.agree: I agree to the <terms>Terms & Conditions</terms> and <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>
register.hint: We'll send a verification link to your email.

verify.title: Verify your email
verify.body: Your account is created. We sent a verification link to {email}. You can log in once the email is verified.
verify.step2: Find the email from Kasku titled "Verifikasi akun"
verify.step3: Tap the link in the email, then come back here and log in
verify.footer: Not in your inbox? Check Spam or Promotions. Wrong email? <link>Sign up again</link>

forgot.title: Forgot password?
forgot.sub: Enter your account email. We'll send a link to create a new password.

forgotSent.title: Check your email
forgotSent.body: If {email} is registered, we've sent a link to create a new password.
forgotSent.step2: Find the email from Kasku titled "Reset kata sandi"
forgotSent.step3: Tap the link within 1 hour, then create a new password
forgotSent.tip: Not in your inbox? Check Spam or Promotions. Typed the wrong email? <link>Change email</link>

reset.title: Create a new password
reset.body: For account {email}. Once saved, you'll be logged out of all other devices.
reset.expiredBody: Reset links are valid for 1 hour and can be used once. Request a new link to continue.
reset.doneBody: You're logged in with your new password. Other devices need to log in again.

account.title: Account
account.installSub: Open like an app, no app store needed

changePassword.title: Change Password
changePassword.intro: For your security, enter your current password before creating a new one.
changePassword.forgot: Forgot? Send a reset link to your email
changePassword.note: You stay logged in on this device. Other devices will need to log in again.
